name: Memories Off #5 Togireta Film
original_name: Memories Off #5 とぎれたフィルム
source:
Haruto Kawai is an aspiring film director, however, upon the death of his best friend, the boy gave up the dream and settled down for a mundane existence until a strange girl pops up in his life.

Life is like a movie, when Mahiro Sendou intrudes into his life, the cameras start moving. With touching storylines and endearing characters, make your own film and experience the climaxes and troughs as well as irreplaceable memories in the newest romantic adventure in the Memories Off series.

[Edited from [url=http://www.play-asia.com/paOS-13-71-9f-49-en-70-346q.html]Play-Asia[/url]]
translation:
河合春人立志成为电影导演。然而，挚友去世后，他放弃梦想，甘于过上平庸的生活，直到一名神秘少女突然闯入他的人生。

人生就像电影。当仙堂麻寻介入春人的生活，摄影机便开始转动。最新一部《秋之回忆》恋爱冒险作品拥有感人至深的故事与惹人喜爱的角色。亲手拍摄属于自己的电影，体验高潮与低谷，并留下无可替代的回忆。

[编辑自[url=http://www.play-asia.com/paOS-13-71-9f-49-en-70-346q.html]Play-Asia[/url]]
